title: ARTS, PARKS, AND CITY FACILITIES COMMITTEE REPORT relative to the negotiation of a new non-profit lease with Urban Alchemy for the use of City-owned space…
text:
[Council File 26-1327; CD 13]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
ARTS, PARKS, AND CITY FACILITIES COMMITTEE REPORT relative to the negotiation of a new non-profit lease with Urban Alchemy for the use of City-owned space at 1710 North Cherokee Avenue, Suite A, for the City’s Crisis and Incident Response through Community-led Engagement (CIRCLE) program.
Recommendation for Council action, pursuant to Motion (Soto-Martinez – Rodriguez):
DIRECT the General Services Department, with the assistance of the City Attorney and the City Administrative Officer (CAO), to negotiate a new no-cost non-profit lease with service provider Urban Alchemy for the use of Suite A of the City-owned space located at 1710 North Cherokee Avenue as part of the City’s CIRCLE program.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Neither the CAO nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Council is asked to direct the negotiation of a new non-profit lease with Urban Alchemy for City-owned space at 1710 North Cherokee Avenue, Suite A, used for the CIRCLE crisis response program.
